text: Why would a father leave his family in a valley with no water?
As he walked away, the mother asked: Has Allah commanded you to do this? He said: yes. She said: Then He will not neglect us.
Out of sight, he prayed: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley, near Your sacred House.
And water came from the ground... the spring of Zamzam, still flowing today.
When Allah commands it... He will not neglect you.
